title: The Real Room 217

lines.text: In 1974, Stephen King checked into Room 217.
The Stanley Hotel, Colorado. Closing for winter. Nearly empty.
That night he dreamed of a fire hose chasing his son.
One cigarette later, he had the bones of The Shining.
But the staff tell an older story.
Chambermaid Elizabeth Wilson walks in with a lit candle.
The blast drops her through the floor, into the dining room.
Guests now report unpacked suitcases, lights switching on and off.
The legend says she's still on shift.
But the record says Elizabeth Wilson survived.
She went back to work at the hotel.
The woman said to haunt 217 didn't die in it.
And the hotel sells ghost tours.
Nobody knows. But it started like this:

shots.description: Cold open, moving at frame 1: Edwardian hotel corridor (corridor builder: white-painted panelled walls, dark-red patterned carpet, brass wall sconces, numbered doors in pairs), night, empty, long perspective. Door '217' (brass numbers) on the right, ajar ~10 cm; a thin line of warm light spills from it across the carpet - the WRONG DETAIL.
shots.camera: slow dolly forward down the corridor centre line, 24 mm, eye height 1.6 m
shots.lighting: sconces dimmed to 30%, warm spill from 217, cold blue at the far end

shots.description: Grand hotel facade variant of house_exterior: long white three/four-storey building, red roof, central cupola, rows of windows (only two lit), set below dark mountains in fog; first snow flurries.
shots.camera: slow crane down + push, 35 mm, from the driveway
shots.lighting: cold blue night, two warm windows, moon behind fog

overlay.text:
THE STANLEY HOTEL
ESTES PARK, COLORADO - 1974

shots.description: Dream sequence, desaturated: the corridor at a dutch angle. A canvas fire hose (simple tube along a path, brass nozzle) slithers along the carpet like a snake toward camera. No child shown; a small shadow runs across the far wall.
shots.camera: low handheld at carpet level, 20 mm, dutch 12 degrees

params.sub: King's own account of the dream

shots.description: Room 217 interior (room builder: high ceiling, tall sash window with mountain view, white wainscoting): brass bed with white cover, wardrobe (box prop), writing desk + chair, a closed brown leather suitcase (box prop with handle) on a luggage rack at the bed's foot. Night. Balcony door/window open; a faceless male silhouette (char_figure, sweater) stands at the window, back to camera; a cigarette ember glows and a smoke wisp rises. On the desk, a typewriter prop (box + roller cylinder + key-bank wedge).
shots.camera: slow push from behind the bed, 35 mm

shots.description: Corridor again, now from the far end looking back at 217 (reverse angle). The ajar door's light is the only warm point.
shots.lighting: sconces off, only 217's spill + cold window at corridor end

shots.description: 1911 flashback, sepia grade: Room 217 with period furnishings, no guests. A wall gas lamp fixture (small brass bracket + glass globe) on the wall; heat-shimmer distortion around it suggests leaking gas.
shots.camera: slow push toward the lamp, 50 mm

shots.description: Same sepia room. Door opens; a faceless female silhouette in a long dress and apron (char_figure, coat=apron) enters, a lit candle in hand; the flame is the brightest point.
shots.camera: static mid-wide from the window side, 35 mm
characters: chambermaid silhouette (faceless, long dress, apron, candle)

shots.description: The candle flame meets the shimmer: hard white flash fills the frame, then a wide shot of the corridor from below with dust raining down and a ragged hole in the floor (simple boolean hole) - no person shown, no injury.
shots.camera: flash -> static low angle, 24 mm, camera shake 0.5 s

shots.description: Present day, Room 217 (Room 217 interior (room builder: high ceiling, tall sash window with mountain view, white wainscoting): brass bed with white cover, wardrobe (box prop), writing desk + chair, a closed brown leather suitcase (box prop with handle) on a luggage rack at the bed's foot). Clean colour grade. The desk lamp flicks off, then on. The suitcase sits CLOSED on the rack. Lock this camera position: S15 reuses it exactly.
shots.camera: slow orbit around the bed, 28 mm

params.sub: guest reports, as told on tours

shots.description: Corridor, far end: the faint faceless silhouette of the chambermaid (semi-transparent, 30% opacity) standing still beside a linen trolley (box on four small wheels). Barely readable.
shots.camera: static long lens 85 mm down the corridor

shots.description: Pattern interrupt: corkboard evidence board. Card 'WHAT THE RECORD SAYS' slams on, then three lines type in. Simple ankle-bone/bandage icon (no injury image).

Daylight version of the corridor (warm, sunlit, colour slowly returning from sepia): the faceless chambermaid silhouette (long dress, apron) walks away from camera carrying a folded stack of white linen (box prop). Ordinary, alive, working.
shots.camera: slow follow dolly behind her, 35 mm

params.sub: returned to work at the hotel (reported)

shots.description: Same board: push onto a final card 'DIED HERE? NO.' with a red line through 'DIED IN 217'.

Night corridor: a small group of 5 faceless silhouettes (char_figure, coats) shuffle past door 217 behind a guide silhouette holding a lantern (point light in a small box frame). The door stays shut. The group exits frame right before the line ends; the final 0.9 s is an empty corridor in total silence (dead air).
shots.camera: static wide, 28 mm, group crosses frame left to right

shots.description: DEAD-AIR REVEAL: the tour shot (S14) ends in 0.9 s of total silence; hard cut on a single soft click to Room 217 in exactly the S09 composition. The suitcase that was CLOSED in S09 is now OPEN and EMPTY; the clothes are folded in neat squares on the bed, shoes paired beneath it. Nothing else moves. Narration L15 lands after the click.
shots.camera: slowest push (3%) toward the folded clothes, 28 mm

shots.description: Loop frame: back to the S01 corridor composition - but door 217 is now CLOSED and the light under it goes out. Then cut to the S01 start frame (door ajar) so the end flows into line 1.
shots.camera: match S01 start position, begin the same dolly
shots.lighting: same as S01; spill light extinguishes at 1.5 s

loop_line: Nobody knows. But it started like this:
